Open Access HTML Article

Abstract

This article is available as HTML in a repository.

Methods

We analyzed 3,200 samples with a Bayesian hierarchical model and adjusted for age, sex, and batch.

Results

The model identified a 1.8-fold increase in the primary outcome for the exposed group.

Limitations

A limitation of this analysis is that the cohort was not population-based, so the estimate may not generalize.
